title: Sets, Subsets, Union and Intersection with Venn Diagrams
seo_title: Grade 7 Sets and Venn Diagrams Worksheets with Answers (MATATAG Math 7)
standard_text: Describe sets and their subsets, the union of sets, and the intersection of sets; illustrate sets and their subsets, the union of sets, and the intersection of sets, through the use of Venn diagrams.
meta_desc: Free Grade 7 sets worksheets for the DepEd MATATAG curriculum: set notation, subsets, union, intersection and Venn diagrams. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: ∪: in A or B. ∩: in both A and B.
key_sub: A set with n elements has 2ⁿ subsets.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A set is a well-defined collection of objects called elements. x ∈ A means x is an element of A.
  • A is a subset of B (A ⊆ B) when every element of A is in B. A set with n elements has 2n subsets, including ∅ and itself.
  • The union A ∪ B has the elements in A or B (or both). The intersection A ∩ B has the elements in both.
  • In a Venn diagram, the overlap of the circles shows A ∩ B.

Examples

Example

A = {1, 2, 3, 4}, B = {3, 4, 5}

A ∪ B = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5}

A ∩ B = {3, 4}

Answer: union and intersection

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Union or intersection?∪: in either set. ∩: in both.
Forgetting ∅The empty set is a subset of every set.
Counting the overlap twiceEach element is listed once in A ∪ B.
